STEP 1 - Scene: A salad plate, shot from above at a slight angle. It holds a small portion of romaine-style leaves with a creamy dressing, some chunks of what looks like cooked chicken or tuna, halved cherry tomatoes, black olives, and a few sunflower or pumpkin seeds. The photo is taken from above, so the plate looks slightly skewed.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The plate is a large square white plate, roughly 26 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 × (13)² ≈ 530 cm² (treating it as a round equivalent).

STEP 3 - Items:
- Romaine/lettuce leaves with dressing
- Chicken or tuna chunks (pale, flaked)
- Cherry tomatoes (4 halves/whole)
- Black olives (about 6)
- Seeds (sunflower/pumpkin), a small scatter
- Creamy dressing coating the leaves

STEP 4 - Area (% of plate ≈ 530 cm²):
- Lettuce with dressing: ~14% (≈75 cm²)
- Chicken/protein chunks: ~3% (≈16 cm²)
- Cherry tomatoes: ~5% (≈27 cm²)
- Olives: ~2% (≈11 cm²)
- Seeds: ~1% (≈5 cm²)
Total food coverage ≈ 25%.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Lettuce: 75 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 190 ml
- Chicken chunks: 16 cm² × 1.0 cm ≈ 16 ml
- Tomatoes: 4 pieces, each ~3 cm × 2.5 cm, roughly 4 × 10 ml ≈ 40 ml (volume of tomato halves/whole)
- Olives: 6 × ~3 ml ≈ 18 ml
- Seeds: ~5 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Lettuce: 190 ml × 0.15 ≈ 28 g
- Chicken: 16 ml × 1.0 ≈ 16 g
- Tomatoes: 40 ml × 0.6 ≈ 24 g
- Olives: 18 ml × 0.9 ≈ 16 g (olives are dense)
- Seeds: 5 ml × 0.5 ≈ 3 g
- Dressing: a thin coating, ~8 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Lettuce with dressing: the dressing adds energy; treat the combined item at ~90 kcal/100 g (creamy Caesar-type dressing on leaves). 28 g → ~25 kcal (lettuce ~15 kcal/100 g plus dressing ~8 g at ~450 kcal/100 g ≈ 36 kcal; total ≈ 40 kcal)
- Chicken: 16 g × 165 ≈ 26 kcal
- Tomatoes: 24 g × 18 ≈ 4 kcal
- Olives: 16 g × 115 ≈ 18 kcal
- Seeds: 3 g × 570 ≈ 17 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 95 g and ≈ 105 kcal. This fits a light side salad with a partly covered plate. It is plausible given the small visible amounts.
